mursili-plague-prayer-inquire-egypt-oath.title: Put the Egyptian oath-breach to an oracle
mursili-plague-prayer-inquire-egypt-oath.description: Having found the old tablet about Egypt, the king makes the matter of the broken oath the subject of an oracle inquiry.
mursili-plague-prayer-inquire-egypt-oath.matchRule: A king submits a found cause of divine anger to oracle inquiry.

mursili-plague-prayer-inquire-mala-offer.title: Put the neglected Mala offering to an oracle
mursili-plague-prayer-inquire-mala-offer.description: The king also asks the oracle about the long-neglected offering to the river Mala; it confirms he must stand before the Storm-god.
mursili-plague-prayer-inquire-mala-offer.matchRule: Oracle inquiry into a neglected cult offering.

mursili-plague-prayer-confess-sin.title: Confess the sin
mursili-plague-prayer-confess-sin.description: Before the Storm-god the king acknowledges the sin: 'it is so, we did it.'
mursili-plague-prayer-confess-sin.matchRule: A first-person confession of a specific offence to the god it angered.

mursili-plague-prayer-vow-mala-offering.title: Vow to perform the Mala offering
mursili-plague-prayer-vow-mala-offering.description: The king undertakes to see to the river Mala offering, and asks that the plague be put right.
mursili-plague-prayer-vow-mala-offering.matchRule: A promise to resume a neglected offering.

mursili-plague-prayer-confess-fathers-si.title: Confess the father's sin
mursili-plague-prayer-confess-fathers-si.description: The king explains that a father's sin reaches his son and confesses Šuppiluliuma's transgression before the Storm-god and the gods.

mursili-plague-prayer-soothe-and-send-aw.title: Ask the god's soul to be soothed and the plague sent away
mursili-plague-prayer-soothe-and-send-aw.description: Because the sin is confessed, the king asks that the soul of the Storm-god and the gods be soothed, that they have pity, and send the plague away.
mursili-plague-prayer-soothe-and-send-aw.matchRule: Request that a god's anger be soothed after confession.

mursili-plague-prayer-hear-me.title: Call on the Storm-god to hear and keep him alive
mursili-plague-prayer-hear-me.description: The king announces his plea about the plague and calls on the Storm-god to hear him and keep him alive.
mursili-plague-prayer-hear-me.matchRule: Direct invocation of a named god to hear a plea.

mursili-plague-prayer-bird-and-servant.title: Argue by the bird and the servant
mursili-plague-prayer-bird-and-servant.description: The king offers comparisons: a bird kept alive in its nest, a servant whose lord hears his plea, a servant forgiven because he confessed.
mursili-plague-prayer-bird-and-servant.matchRule: Rhetorical analogy of lord and servant addressed to a god.

mursili-plague-prayer-offer-compensation.title: Offer further compensation
mursili-plague-prayer-offer-compensation.description: The king argues the land has already paid twentyfold through the plague, yet undertakes to give any further compensation the god reveals in a dream.
mursili-plague-prayer-offer-compensation.matchRule: Promise of restitution to an offended god on revelation.

mursili-plague-prayer-spare-cult-personn.title: Ask that the remaining cult personnel die no more
mursili-plague-prayer-spare-cult-personn.description: While he sets the matter right, the king asks that the surviving bread-offerers and libation-pourers die no more.
mursili-plague-prayer-spare-cult-personn.matchRule: Plea that those who feed the gods be spared.

mursili-plague-prayer-reveal-other-cause.title: Ask for any other cause to be revealed
mursili-plague-prayer-reveal-other-cause.description: If people die for another reason, the king asks to see it in a dream, by oracle, or through a man of god.
mursili-plague-prayer-reveal-other-cause.matchRule: Request for divine disclosure through dream, oracle or prophet.

mursili-plague-prayer-order-pure-sleep.title: Order the priests to sleep in purity
mursili-plague-prayer-order-pure-sleep.description: The king has ordered all (probably priests) to sleep regularly in purity, apparently to receive dreams.
mursili-plague-prayer-order-pure-sleep.matchRule: Ordered sleep in a state of purity to receive a dream.
